This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''miner''' worked on a offshore [[Mining/Legends|mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. Together with the [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Guerra Derida]], he warned the captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] about the dangers of [[ionite]] mining by telling him a story about the miner [[Bier]].
